newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Hub Power plant nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Hub Power plant nearly complete.

text.p: Pakistan's Hub Power Co Ltd said on Sunday its 1,292-megawatt power station would be completed before February 1997, ahead of schedule.

A company statement said the commissioning of its fourth and final 323-MW unit was proceeding ahead of schedule and was expected to be in commercial operation before February, rather than March as earlier planned.
The company said its third unit had begun commercial operation on October 9, seven weeks ahead of schedule.

It said the total capacity available to the state-run Water and Power Development Authority from the power plant had reached 900 megawatts. The second of two transmission lines linking the plant to the national grid came into service in late October.
Shares of Hub Power, building a $1.8 billion plant at Hub Chowki near Karachi, closed 0.10 rupee up at 34.75 rupees on the Karachi Stock Exchange on Sunday.
